name: Frozen Lake Minnesota 2023
information: All competitors must read the Health & Safety tab. By registering for the competition, you are agreeing to follow all guidelines listed. Please read the Competitor Information tab to better prepare yourself for the competition. In order for your registration to be accepted, you must register and pay for the competition. We are holding Kilominx as an extra event at this competition. For more information, read the Extra Event: Kilominx tab.
